caribbean.headline: Grand Cayman Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds
caribbean.paragraph: Grand Cayman is experiencing 100% rain probability, with maximum sustained winds of 11 kt and wave heights up to 4.4 ft. Roatan is experiencing maximum sustained winds of 23 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Ports Brace for Heavy Rain and Moderate Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing 12 kt winds, 2.5 ft waves, 100% rain probability, and a 4 s swell from the east. Mykonos will see 24 kt winds and clear skies.
